Lossless multipart prologue/wire/replay and TUI submit/adoption assertions
Batch export compared to private-state-enabled export projection with non-null sidecar
Legacy missing-ledger fixtures explicitly omit source/destination table while modern destination initializes empty ledger
Recovery verifies nonzero owner generation and exact non-null sidecar survive

details.production_fix: Cron validates readable config before identity/source/script/provider work and converts parse/config failure into the structured run_job failure result. Script-only jobs and ignore-user-config cannot bypass unreadable identity policy. Valid legacy no-agent behavior remains covered.
fixture_repairs: CLI/TUI completion claim doubles accept owner_context and assert trusted caller context, not forged event identity; denied claims never enqueue/acknowledge or retain a busy turn.
API presentation mock agents explicitly carry no runtime context or memory manager.
Rebound bot live delivery fixture supplies contextlib required by production server globals.

delivery_classification.pending_attempts_zero: Known never-attempted intent: eligible for one claimed recovery send.
delivery_classification.send_path_degraded: Explicit adapter never-dispatched failure: retry eligible; exact original recipient and content preserved.
delivery_classification.flood_control_or_unclassified_failure: May follow accepted chunks: outcome_unknown, retained, no recovery retry.
delivery_classification.interrupted_attempting_or_crash_left_rep: Possibly accepted; outcome_unknown, retained, no recovery retry or automatic inference resume.
delivery_classification.accepted_send_before_ack: Journal proves acceptance, durable state remains unknown; never automatically resent.
delivery_classification.claimed_batch_then_crash: Both accepted first member and unsent siblings have ambiguous durable dispatch state; all remain unknown without replay.

details.qualification: Conservative recovery after ledger return is proven by real SIGKILL and concurrent reboot tests. Legacy pre-ledger inline retries remain bounded but are not certified exactly-once or safe for every ambiguous acceptance. Strict external adapters remain unqualified. No actual external sends, live data, installs, staging, commit, or push.
